jql.description: JQL filter and optional ORDER BY clause; omitted or empty means Jira's unfiltered visible-issue search.

limit.description: Maximum issues requested for this page; default 50. Jira may cap it lower.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this tool for the same connection, query, custom-field selection and limit; omit for the first page.

customFieldIds.description: Additional custom-field IDs whose JSON values to return; omitted or [] requests none.

items.description: Jira custom-field ID to include.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_s.description: JQL search and one-page continuation options.

labels.description: Issue labels when returned; empty array means no labels.

items.description: Issue label.

dueDate.description: Calendar due date, or null if explicitly unset; never timezone-shifted.

statusId.description: Opaque current status ID when returned.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC RFC 3339 when returned and interpretable.

projectId.description: Opaque owning project ID when returned.

updatedAt.description: Last update instant normalized to UTC RFC 3339 when returned and interpretable.

priorityId.description: Priority ID; null when explicitly unset, omitted if unavailable.

statusName.description: Current status display name when returned.

description.description: Issue description text; null preserves an explicitly unset description; omitted if not returned.

issueTypeId.description: Opaque issue type ID when returned.

customFields.description: Requested custom field values keyed by field ID, preserving plugin-defined structure, nulls and empty values; omitted fields are not synthesized.

additionalProperties.description: JSON value retaining the custom field's opaque plugin-defined meaning.

assigneeUsername.description: Assignee username, null for an explicitly unassigned issue, omitted if unavailable.

items.description: Normalized core issue fields and requested opaque custom-field values.
One page of visible matching issues in Jira's query order.

total.description: Matching total reported by Jira at request time, when available; not a snapshot guarantee.

items.description: Warning reported by Jira.

warnings.description: Provider warning messages, including search restrictions when reported; [] when none.

nextCursor.description: Opaque continuation; omitted when no retrievable next page remains.

searchWindowLimit.description: Provider maximum retrievable search window when reported; null means unlimited.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: One normalized issue page with provider totals, search-window information and continuation.

tags.instructions: Use a JQL expression, including ORDER BY when ordering matters. Omit jql to browse visible issues. Each call returns one page, not the whole result set. Pass nextCursor back as cursor without changing jql, customFieldIds or limit. limit is 1–100, default 50; Jira may impose a smaller page or search window. Custom fields retain their plugin-defined JSON meaning.

functions.name: search-users
functions.description: Find users matching a username, display name, or email query, with active and inactive account choices.

limit.description: Maximum users in this page, within Jira's first-100 search window.

query.description: Search text matched by Jira against username, name, or email address.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation from this search with the same query and account flags.

includeActive.description: Include active accounts; defaults to true.

includeInactive.description: Include inactive accounts; defaults to false.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_s.description: User search query, account-state filters, and optional page continuation.

active.description: Whether the account is active, when returned.

deleted.description: Whether Jira marks the user deleted, when returned.

items.description: A matching Jira user with visible account information.
Matching users in this search page.

nextCursor.description: Continuation within the first 100 matching users; absence does not prove no additional matches exist outside that window.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: One page of matching users within Jira's first-100 search window.

tags.instructions: Use for name or email discovery; use `get-user` for a known identity or `list-users` for the directory. Return one page at a time by passing nextCursor back with the same query and flags. Jira exposes only the first 100 matching users through this search; narrow the query to find more. Limit defaults to 50 and is at most 100.

functions.name: update-component
functions.description: Partially update a component's name, description, lead, assignee policy, or archived state.

componentId.description: Opaque identifier of the component to modify.

archived.description: Requested archived state; false requests unarchiving.

description.description: Replacement description; empty string clears it, omission preserves it.

leadUsername.description: Replacement lead username; empty string requests clearing the lead, omission preserves it.

changes.description: Partial modifications; omitted fields remain unchanged.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: Identify a component and supply only the settings to change.

id.description: Opaque component identifier, unchanged by this update.

description.description: Resulting description; empty preserved, absent omitted.

assigneeType.description: Resulting default assignee policy, when supplied.

leadUsername.description: Resulting lead username; omitted if none or unavailable.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: Resulting component metadata returned by Jira after the partial update.

tags.instructions: Obtain componentId from `get-component`, `create-component`, or the project's component collection. Supply only fields to change. This overwrites supplied settings; archived false requests an unarchived component. Use `delete-component` for deletion, which can also change issue associations.

functions.name: update-filter
functions.description: Partially update a filter's query, name or description. Administrators may also transfer its ownership.

jql.description: Replacement JQL; empty string requests an unrestricted query if Jira accepts it.

description.description: Replacement description; empty string clears it, omission preserves it.

ownerUsername.description: New owner's Jira username; administrator authority is required.

changes.description: Partial modifications; omitted properties remain unchanged.

filterId.description: Opaque identifier of the filter to modify.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: A saved filter and the intended partial modifications.

id.description: Filter identifier, unchanged by the update.

jql.description: Resulting JQL query as ordinary text.

viewUrl.description: URL for opening the resulting filter's results.

editable.description: Whether the connected user can edit the resulting filter, when reported.

favourite.description: Reported favourite state; this tool does not modify it.

description.description: Resulting description; empty preserved and absent omitted.

sharePermissions.description: Reported sharing grants; this tool does not modify them.

id.description: Opaque sharing grant identifier, when supplied.

roleId.description: Granted project role identifier, when applicable.

items.description: A reported sharing grant.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: The resulting saved filter metadata reported by Jira.

tags.instructions: Get the filter ID and current metadata with `get-filter`. Supply only intended changes. Owner changes require administrator authority and may change who can edit the filter. This cannot change favourites or sharing grants. Use `create-filter` for a new saved query.

functions.name: update-issue
functions.description: Modify selected fields of an issue while preserving omitted fields, with explicit control over watcher notifications.

labels.description: Complete replacement label collection; empty array clears labels.

items.description: An issue label.

dueDate.description: Replacement due calendar date; null clears it.

description.description: Replacement description in Jira text syntax; null clears it and empty string is sent explicitly.

additionalFields.description: Other editable field IDs and replacement values; null clears a field only where metadata/provider rules allow it. Cannot duplicate named changes.

additionalProperties.description: Replacement value for an editable Jira field.

changes.description: Partial field changes; omitted fields remain unchanged.

notifyUsers.description: Whether Jira should notify watchers; false requires administrator or project-administrator permission.

issueIdOrKey.description: Existing issue identifier or key.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: Selected issue field replacements and watcher notification preference.

updated.description: Jira accepted the requested changes; not a delivery receipt for notifications.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue reference supplied by the caller.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: Acknowledgment that Jira accepted the issue field changes.

tags.instructions: Get the issue with `get-issue` and discover editable fields with `get-issue-edit-fields`. Use `update-issue-workflow-state` to execute a workflow transition and `update-issue-assignee` for assignment. Disabling notifications requires administrator or project-administrator permission.

functions.name: update-issue-assignee
functions.description: Replace an issue's assignee with a specified Jira user.

username.description: Jira username of the intended assignee, not a display name or cloud account ID.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue identifier or key to assign.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: Issue reference and Jira username for replacing the assignee.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue reference whose assignment was accepted.

assigneeUsername.description: Username submitted as the new assignee.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: Accepted issue assignment, echoing the submitted issue reference and username.

tags.instructions: Provide an issue reference from `get-issue` and the user's Jira username. Use `update-issue` for other fields. Assignment can replace an existing assignee and requires assignment permission.

functions.name: update-issue-comment
functions.description: Partially modify a comment's body or visibility while retaining omitted values.

issueIdOrKey.description: Containing issue identifier or key.

commentId.description: Identifier of the comment to edit.

body.description: Replacement comment text in Jira syntax; null and empty text are not accepted.

visibility.description: Replacement restriction; null removes it, omission preserves it.

changes.description: Partial changes; omission preserves existing values.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: Issue comment identifiers and the editable values to replace.

updatedAt.description: Last edit instant normalized to UTC Z preserving precision.

visibility.description: Returned restriction; explicit null is unrestricted and omission means unavailable.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: Stored comment text, identifier, and available edit and visibility details.

tags.instructions: Get commentId from `list-issue-comments`. Use `get-issue-comment` to inspect the existing comment. Omitted fields remain unchanged; visibility=null removes the restriction and may broaden readership. Use `create-issue-comment` for a new comment.

functions.name: update-issue-workflow-state
functions.description: Execute an available issue workflow action and set transition-screen fields in the same request.

fieldValues.description: Transition-screen field IDs and values; omitted fields are not explicitly modified. Null or empty values are validated by Jira.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue identifier or key to transition.

transitionId.description: Available workflow action ID from list-issue-transitions.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: Issue workflow action and optional transition-screen field values.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue reference submitted for the action.

transitionId.description: Workflow action ID accepted by Jira.

transitioned.description: Jira accepted the transition, not a guarantee of a particular future status or notification delivery.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: Acknowledgment that Jira accepted the submitted workflow action.

tags.instructions: First use `list-issue-transitions` to obtain the action ID and required fields. A status ID is not a transition ID. Use `update-issue` for ordinary field edits. Transitions can run workflow side effects; do not replay an ambiguous result without checking the issue.

functions.name: update-issue-worklog
functions.description: Partially modify an existing worklog and optionally adjust the issue's remaining estimate.

issueIdOrKey.description: Containing issue identifier or key.

comment.description: Replacement work description; empty string explicitly clears text, null is not accepted.

startedAt.description: Replacement work start instant with explicit offset and at most millisecond precision.

visibility.description: Replacement restriction; null removes it, omission preserves it.

timeSpentSeconds.description: Replacement logged duration in whole seconds.

changes.description: Partial editable fields; omitted values remain unchanged.

mode.description: Leave estimate unchanged, ask Jira to adjust automatically, or set a new estimate.

minutes.description: Replacement estimate in whole minutes, required only for new.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: Existing issue worklog, partial field changes, and optional remaining-estimate policy.

timeSpentSeconds.description: Stored logged duration in whole seconds.

startedAt.description: Stored work start instant normalized to UTC Z preserving precision.

updatedAt.description: Last edit instant normalized to UTC Z preserving precision.

visibility.description: Returned restriction; null unrestricted, omission unavailable.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: Updated stored worklog fields returned by Jira.

tags.instructions: Use `get-issue-worklog` to inspect the entry first. Omitted fields stay unchanged. A changed value is required, not merely a repeated existing value. Estimate adjustment defaults to leave; updating supports leave, auto and new, not manual. visibility=null removes a restriction.

functions.name: update-project
functions.description: Partially update a project's identity, description, lead and administrative configuration. Requires project-update authority.

projectIdOrKey.description: Existing project ID or key; use the current value even when changing its key.

key.description: New project key subject to Jira's naming and uniqueness rules.

url.description: Replacement website URL; empty string requests clearing.

categoryId.description: Replacement decimal project category ID; no removal sentinel is inferred.

description.description: Replacement description; empty string clears the text.

leadUsername.description: Existing username to make project lead.

projectTypeKey.description: Replacement installed project type key, subject to Jira validation.

projectTemplateKey.description: Replacement installed project template key, if supported for this project.

notificationSchemeId.description: Replacement decimal project notification scheme ID.

issueSecuritySchemeId.description: Replacement decimal issue security scheme ID.

changes.description: Partial settings modification. Omitted fields remain unchanged; null is rejected.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: An existing project and the non-null settings to update.

key.description: Current project key after the update.

avatarUrls.description: Current avatar URLs keyed by size label, when returned.

additionalProperties.description: Avatar URL for this size label.

description.description: Current project description when returned; empty text is preserved.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: The updated project identity and any returned descriptive fields.

tags.instructions: Use `list-projects` or `get-project` to identify the project. Supply only settings to change. Empty description clears it; null is not a clearing instruction. Updating key or schemes can affect issue access and workflows. Use `create-project` for a new project. Scheme and template IDs must come from the Jira administrator.

functions.name: update-sprint
functions.description: Partially change a non-closed sprint's name, goal, dates and scheduling settings. Editing dates on a synced sprint requires Jira administrator authority.

goal.description: Replacement goal; empty string removes the goal.

name.description: Replacement sprint name; whitespace-only names are rejected.

endAt.description: Replacement end instant with explicit offset and at most millisecond precision.

synced.description: Replacement Jira synced-sprint flag; false requests unsyncing.

startAt.description: Replacement start instant with explicit offset and at most millisecond precision; no null-clearing behavior is inferred.

incompleteIssuesDestinationId.description: Replacement decimal destination ID for incomplete issues; no backlog sentinel is invented.

changes.description: Partial modification; omitted properties remain unchanged and null is rejected.

sprintId.description: Opaque decimal ID of the sprint to modify.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: Identify a sprint and supply only the sprint settings to change.

goal.description: Current goal when returned, including empty text.

endAt.description: Current planned end instant in UTC when set.

synced.description: Current Jira synced flag when returned.

startAt.description: Current planned start instant in UTC when set.

activatedAt.description: Actual activation instant in UTC when returned.

completedAt.description: Actual completion instant in UTC when returned.

autoStartStop.description: Current automatic start/stop setting when returned.

originBoardId.description: Opaque origin board ID when returned.

incompleteIssuesDestinationId.description: Current opaque incomplete-issue destination ID when returned.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: Updated sprint settings with opaque string IDs and UTC timestamps.

tags.instructions: Inspect with `get-sprint` first. Supply only settings to change; goal='' removes the goal. Closed sprints cannot be updated. Use `update-sprint-to-active` or `update-sprint-to-closed` for lifecycle changes. Set synced=false before `delete-sprint` when necessary. Date edits on synced sprints require a Jira administrator.

functions.name: update-sprint-to-active
functions.description: Start a future sprint, using its existing dates or replacement start/end instants.

endAt.description: Optional replacement end instant; omit to keep the existing date.

startAt.description: Optional replacement start instant, explicit offset and at most millisecond precision; omit to keep the existing date.

sprintId.description: Opaque decimal ID of the future sprint to start.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: Future sprint to start and optional replacement planned instants.

endAt.description: Planned end instant normalized to UTC when returned.

state.description: State returned by Jira after starting, expected active.

startAt.description: Planned start instant normalized to UTC when returned.

activatedAt.description: Actual activation instant normalized to UTC when returned.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: Stored sprint after starting, with returned instants normalized to UTC.

tags.instructions: Use `get-sprint` first. Only a future sprint can start, and both start and end dates must be set. Supply missing dates here or set them through `update-sprint`. Starting changes lifecycle state; use `update-sprint-to-closed` to finish an active sprint.

functions.name: update-sprint-to-closed
functions.description: Complete an active sprint, optionally specifying the destination for incomplete issues.

sprintId.description: Opaque decimal ID of the active sprint to complete.

incompleteIssuesDestinationId.description: Optional opaque decimal destination ID for incomplete issues; omission preserves Jira's configured/default destination. No backlog sentinel is inferred.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: The active sprint to complete and an optional destination for incomplete issues.

state.description: State returned after completion, expected closed.

completedAt.description: Provider-assigned completion instant normalized to UTC when returned.

incompleteIssuesDestinationId.description: Destination ID returned by Jira when available; not per-issue move confirmation.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: The completed sprint returned by Jira, without per-issue relocation guarantees.

tags.instructions: Use `get-sprint` and `list-sprint-issues` first. Only active sprints can complete. Completed parent issues with incomplete subtasks block completion. Moving issues to another sprint requires issue-edit permission. Jira sets completion time; it cannot be supplied manually. Completion cannot be reversed through these tools.

functions.name: update-user
functions.description: Modify selected profile, login, credential, active-state or application-access details of a Jira user. Requires permission to edit that account.

active.description: Replacement active state; false requests deactivation.

password.description: Replacement password; omitted leaves it unchanged and it is never returned.

username.description: Replacement login name; not the current identity selector.

displayName.description: Replacement display name; cannot be cleared through this contract.

emailAddress.description: Replacement email text; empty requests clearing subject to Jira's policy.

applicationKeys.description: Replacement application-access keys; empty requests removal of all application access.

items.description: An application-access key to grant.

notificationFormat.description: Replacement Jira notification-format value, such as HTML; not an email-send flag.

changes.description: Partial account changes. Omitted fields stay unchanged; null is not accepted.

userKey.description: Opaque key of the account to edit; excludes username.

username.description: Current login name identifying the account; excludes userKey.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: Identify exactly one Jira user by key or current username and supply only the account changes to apply.

id.description: Opaque key of the updated user.

username.description: Login name returned after the update.

emailAddress.description: Updated email address, when returned; may be empty after clearing.

applicationKeys.description: Application keys returned after the update; empty means none.

items.description: An application key returned for the updated user.

notificationFormat.description: Notification-format value returned after the update.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: Updated Jira user identity and the account details returned by Jira, excluding passwords.

tags.instructions: Use `get-user` or `search-users` to obtain a user key or current username first. Supply only changes; omitted properties remain unchanged. Prefer userKey when renaming. Setting active=false disables the account rather than deleting it; `delete-user` removes the user and references. Passwords are never returned. Recheck the account before repeating an uncertain write.

functions.name: update-version
functions.description: Partially modify a Jira version's name, description, release/archive state and dates, including clearing dates.

versionId.description: Opaque ID of the version to edit.

name.description: Replacement version name; cannot be cleared.

startAt.description: Replacement start instant with explicit offset, or null to clear; omission preserves it.

archived.description: Replacement archived state; false returns the version from archived state.

released.description: Replacement released state; false marks it unreleased.

releaseAt.description: Replacement release instant with explicit offset, or null to clear; omission preserves it.

description.description: Replacement description; empty string clears the text.

changes.description: Partial changes; omitted properties remain unchanged.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: Identify a Jira version and supply only the fields to change.

id.description: Opaque ID of the version whose update was accepted.

updated.description: Jira accepted the version update; does not assert deployment or a returned resource snapshot.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: Acknowledgement that Jira accepted the version update.

tags.instructions: Obtain the version ID from `create-version` or the project's version list; inspect it with `get-version` when needed. Omitted changes are preserved. Use null for a date to clear it and empty text to clear the description. Changing release or archive flags affects version state, not deployment. Recheck with `get-version` after an uncertain write.

functions.name: upload-issue-attachment
functions.description: Upload exact file bytes as a new attachment to an issue.

filename.description: Attachment filename including extension, preserved as Unicode.

mimeType.description: File media type; defaults to application/octet-stream.

issueIdOrKey.description: Issue identifier or key receiving the attachment.

contentBase64.description: RFC 4648 base64 of exact binary bytes; decoded content must not exceed 5 MiB.

FunctionInput_jira_data_center_api_key_u.description: Issue reference and exact file bytes for one new attachment.

mimeType.description: Media type returned by Jira, if available.

createdAt.description: Creation instant normalized to UTC Z, preserving source precision.

contentUrl.description: Jira URL for the content; access may require Jira authentication.

FunctionOutput_jira_data_center_api_key_.description: The single attachment created by Jira.

tags.instructions: Use an issue reference from `get-issue`. Supply base64 of the exact file bytes, not a URL or multipart document. Use `batch-upload-issue-attachments` for up to ten files in one request. The local file cap is 5 MiB; the Jira instance may allow less. A retry can create a duplicate attachment.
